g.text: Fixed sparse policy; the two probe conditions are within their respective training supports
Diamonds and bars: mean +/- sample SD across 3 trained seeds; small markers: individual seeds. All probes: 2,048 ticks.
Rates use matured primary requests; right-censored requests are excluded. Source h/world states differ across checkpoints.
